claimType: exploratory mechanism/representation study on already-exposed U3b scenes; not confirmatory efficacy evidence
motivation: U3c showed that scalar TSDF reweighting has little mechanical leverage: median naive-vs-relative fusion leverage is zero in all five rooms, conflict+mixed-confidence voxels are uncommon, and only a small minority of surface-active voxels move by >=0.25 voxel. U4a therefore moves uncertainty from averaging weights into the decision of whether an observation is allowed to establish or extend surface support.

dataReuse.volumeBounds: reuse exact U3b prepared bounds/voxel size/truncation/maximum accumulated weight
dataReuse.poses: reuse exact U3b camera-to-world FARO-registered poses
dataReuse.reference: reuse exact U3b FARO reference point cloud
dataReuse.confidence: reuse exact U3b uint8 confidence 0/128/255 normalized by /255
dataReuse.shuffledConfidence: reuse exact U3b deterministic within-scene shuffled confidence sidecars

intervention.name: uncertainty-anchored-support-fusion
intervention.principle: Uncertainty changes whether an observation may establish topology, not the scalar weight used after admission.
intervention.anchorCriterion: an observation is a high-certainty anchor iff predictive sigma <= 0.5 * scene voxelSizeMetres
intervention.anchorThresholdRationale: sub-half-voxel predictive standard deviation is a scale-adaptive criterion for observations precise enough to establish surface support without a scene-specific tuned threshold

anchorPass.geometry: same TSDF signed-distance/truncation/projection rules as the existing dense CPU oracle
anchorPass.purpose: construct a support field only; anchor-pass geometry is diagnostic and is not the U4a candidate output

supportQuery.surfacePoint: world-space point obtained by back-projecting the observed depth pixel and applying the frozen camera-to-world pose
supportQuery.lookup: nearest dense voxel containing the predicted surface point
supportQuery.surfaceBandRationale: same quarter-truncation normalized surface neighborhood frozen in U3c; no FARO outcome is used to choose it

intervention.finalAdmission: anchors are admitted; a non-anchor observation is admitted only when its predicted surface point satisfies the frozen anchor support query
intervention.finalFusionWeight: original naive confidence c=confidenceU8/255 for every admitted observation
intervention.importantIsolation: calibrated sigma is never converted into a scalar final TSDF precision weight in U4a

methods.definition: original U3b naive-confidence reconstruction; no rerun required for the baseline metric

methods.supportSigma: sigmaCalibrated using the frozen shuffled confidence assignment
methods.finalConfidence: original intact confidence; shuffle affects support decisions only

evaluation.geometry: same FARO evaluation script/settings as U3b; no alignment; Chamfer mean primary descriptive geometry metric; F@5cm precision/recall secondary

descriptiveComparisons.warning: All five scenes are already exposed. Intervals and correlations are descriptive/hypothesis-generating only and cannot be promoted to confirmatory evidence.

mechanismInterpretation.promising: If calibrated anchored support improves precision/Chamfer on multiple scenes without severe recall collapse and shuffled support is directionally worse, then uncertainty affecting topology/support is a plausible mechanism worth a new untouched U4b confirmatory study.
mechanismInterpretation.overPruning: If precision improves but recall/completeness collapses, the support rule is too conservative; record this as an exploratory failure rather than tuning the threshold on these scenes.
mechanismInterpretation.noEffect: If calibrated anchored support remains nearly identical to naive/depth-only, externally calibrated uncertainty still has insufficient leverage at this representation level; move U4b toward explicit multimodal/hybrid surface hypotheses or Gaussian support rather than further TSDF gating.
mechanismInterpretation.shuffledNotWorse: If shuffled confidence performs similarly or better, do not attribute any geometry change to calibrated confidence association.

confirmatoryBoundary.futureU4bRequirement: Any positive efficacy claim requires a separately frozen untouched scene set and thresholds fixed before asset/geometry exposure.

literaturePositioning.note: U4a deliberately moves toward uncertainty as part of spatial support/representation, consistent with probabilistic SDF/hybrid-representation work, while remaining distinct from recent sparse-view Gaussian methods that use learned uncertainty or depth/normal regularization inside image-driven optimization.
